_comment: Every app-visible change serial 13 makes against serial 12 (scripts/validate.py --declared ci/serial13-declared.json --baseline ci/serial3-baseline.json --previous-ref <serial 12> --distros compat/distros.json). UNPUBLISHED DRAFT (2026-11-11): meshTerm docs/plan-2.5-navigation.md S9 (Detached Install Updates, Finish Update), app 2.5.

changes.reason: Changed (meshTerm S9.2 H4, Q-S9-4; 2026-11-12): (1) apt-get install gains -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold, so a changed config file keeps the admin's copy (the new default lands as .dpkg-dist) instead of prompting. (2) Where systemd runs (/run/systemd/system and systemd-run), the install runs in a transient unit (systemd-run --wait --pipe --collect --quiet, DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive, NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1): its output still streams to the session and its exit status is the line's, but it is outside the SSH session's process tree and cgroup, so the session being killed (Tailscale SSH sessions live in tailscaled's cgroup and die when the tailscale package restarts tailscaled: Pharos, 2026-11-11) no longer kills dpkg half way. (3) After a successful install on such a host with /usr/sbin/needrestart, {{sudo}}systemd-run --on-active=5 --collect --quiet needrestart -r a -l -f noninteractive || : starts needrestart in its own transient timer unit (automatic restarts, libraries only), putting back the service restarts the suspend skipped; it starts after the marker and cannot restart the install's unit. Measured in Docker (ubuntu:24.04, systemd PID 1, needrestart 3.6-7ubuntu4 and 3.6-7ubuntu4.5). 2.4.0 / 2.4.1 fetch it and still accept it (the real readers, compiled, and compat_check), and run it attached as before; with no systemd the line is the serial 12 line plus the confdef options.

Changed (2026-11-12): where systemd runs, dnf runs in a transient unit (systemd-run --wait --pipe --collect --quiet) for the same reason as security-updates.apt: outside the SSH session's cgroup, so a killed session cannot stop the transaction (rpm already defers SIGTERM during a transaction, but a unit stop escalates to SIGKILL after its timeout). No needrestart step (dnf has no needrestart hook to suspend). Without systemd the line is the serial 12 line. 2.4.0 / 2.4.1 accept it (measured with the compiled readers and compat_check).

New intent (meshTerm 2.5 S9): Install Updates detached from the SSH connection, so a tailscale or openssh-server upgrade that drops the session cannot leave dpkg half configured (Pharos, 2026-11-11). The body's command is security-updates.apt's, with the {{packages}} names passed as "$@". The launcher (byte-identical across the four detached.* lines) runs as root under the ONE {{sudo}}: trap "" HUP, umask 022, the lock /run/meshterm-pkg.lock (a symlink naming the run; busy = exit 75), the claim (/var/log/meshterm/<kind>-<id>.state and run.state, written before detaching), then systemd-run --unit=meshterm-<kind>-<id> --collect --quiet -p Type=exec (an exec failure is synchronous and takes setsid at once) or setsid; neither = fail=start, exit 71. Values reach the scripts only as positional arguments; the body holds no ${ or $$ (systemd expands both in a unit argument; the validators refuse them) and exports LC_ALL=C DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive APT_LISTCHANGES_FRONTEND=none NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1 (measured on ubuntu:24.04 with the release-pocket needrestart 3.6-7ubuntu4, LP #2067482: without it needrestart restarts the unit mid-run, Type=oneshot and Type=exec alike). 2.4.x and older never ask for detached.* and read {{runid}} as a later placeholder (variant unusable), so they keep the file. Restarts (2026-11-12): after rc= and ended= are written, and only when rc is 0, the body runs systemd-run --on-active=5 --collect -q needrestart -r a -l -f noninteractive 2>/dev/null: needrestart in its own transient timer unit, after the body has exited and released the lock, so it never restarts the run's unit, never changes rc= and never holds /run/meshterm-pkg.lock; without systemd or needrestart it fails silently.
New intent (meshTerm 2.5 S9): the same for AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux and RHEL; the body runs dnf --refresh upgrade -y "$@" (capitalised rpm names, as security-updates.dnf).
New intent (meshTerm 2.5 S9): the same for Alpine (OpenRC: the setsid path); the body runs apk -U upgrade "$@".

New intent (meshTerm 2.5 S9.5, Finish Update): finish an interrupted dpkg run in the background with dpkg --force-confdef --force-confold --configure -a (keep the admin's config). Same launcher; no {{packages}}. Restarts (2026-11-12): after rc= and ended= are written, and only when rc is 0, the body runs systemd-run --on-active=5 --collect -q needrestart -r a -l -f noninteractive 2>/dev/null: needrestart in its own transient timer unit, after the body has exited and released the lock, so it never restarts the run's unit, never changes rc= and never holds /run/meshterm-pkg.lock; without systemd or needrestart it fails silently.

New intent (meshTerm 2.5 S9.5): Finish Update's plain line, shown, copied and run in Open Terminal (and attached when the background start is not possible): {{sudo}}dpkg --force-confdef --force-confold --configure -a. apt-get -f install is never offered (it can remove packages).
